objectives.title: Own the server
objectives.prompt: Get SYSTEM or local Administrator on the Metasploitable 3 Windows Server 2008 R2 machine and read C:\ctf\flag.txt.
hints: Scan every port: several web applications run old releases with public advisories.
Some services run as SYSTEM, so a remote code execution bug in one of them is the whole way in. The Metasploitable 3 wiki lists the intended vulnerabilities.
Landed as a low-privileged service account? Look for a local privilege escalation to SYSTEM.

steps.title: Fingerprint the search engine
steps.prompt: Which version of Elasticsearch answers on port 9200?

steps.title: Find the advisory
steps.prompt: Which CVE covers code execution through dynamic scripting in that Elasticsearch release?

steps.title: Another service
steps.prompt: Which continuous integration server answers on port 8484? (name only)

steps.title: Name the feature
steps.prompt: Which built-in feature of that CI server runs Groovy code for an administrator, and is reachable here without logging in? (two words)
